pr_body:
@mark-vieira / @breskeby  - Can you take a quick peek at the direction here ?  I am in need of the ability to apply the functionality of MavenFilteringHack when copying YAML tests around, but the CopyRestTestsTask isn't a proper Copy task. To avoid duplication and re-use of the Maven standard `${`foo`}`, this change will also remove the MavenFilteringHack and update all placeholder tokens to `@`foo`@` which is the Ant default value which allows for less custom code. 

Note - This is a draft PR until I double check that I got all of the `${`foo`}` (I did this draft pretty quickly) and do a bit more manual testing. 

Note 2 - for my needs I could get away with just the updates to the CopyRestTestTask ... but that would require either 2 ways to represent placeholders or duplicating/re-using the Maven conventions. 

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/71434
